title: Jo, Ha, Trapdoor
premise: Free introductions, drawn-out melody, asymmetric pulse and a fast exit: an original jo–ha–kyū-inspired trajectory, with early previews, counterpoint, brief detours, and no borrowed gagaku melody.
pitch_policy: Exact original-field pitches only; all octave/register changes choose another existing pitch. Fixed common-tone bridges are allowed; no note is retuned while held.
